report_name: Phishing Campaign Targets 9,000+ Orgs with Debt-Relief Lures

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: A large-scale phishing campaign sent approximately 24,700 debt-relief-themed emails to over 9,000 organizations to initiate contact with victims.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing for Information
attack_patterns.description: The campaign used vishing (voice phishing) to collect sensitive personal and financial information from victims who called the provided phone numbers.

campaigns.name: Debt-Relief Vishing Campaign
campaigns.description: A large-scale vishing campaign active in August 2026 that used debt-relief themed emails to lure victims into calling scammer-controlled phone numbers to steal financial and personal data.

identities.name: Over 9,000 Organizations
identities.description: A class of over 9,000 organizations targeted by a large-scale debt-relief vishing campaign over a two-week period.

infrastructure.name: Vishing Call Center
infrastructure.description: Call centers controlled by scammers to conduct voice phishing (vishing) and persuade victims to divulge sensitive information over the phone.

indicators.name: Debt-Relief Vishing Lure Detection
indicators.pattern:
title: Debt-Relief Vishing Lure Email
id: 2b9e1c4a-8f7d-4b1e-9c6a-0d3e2f1a0b9c
status: experimental
description: Detects emails with lures related to debt relief programs that prompt the user to call a phone number, a common vishing tactic.
references:
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/31th-august-threat-intelligence-report/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-01
tags:
  - attack.t1566
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1598
  - attack.reconnaissance
level: medium
logsource:
  category: email
detection:
  selection_keywords:
    Body|contains|all:
      - 'debt'
      - 'relief'
  selection_cta:
    Body|contains:
      - 'call now to claim'
      - 'call our agents'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects email content related to debt-relief phishing lures that direct recipients to call a phone number.
